top_signals.title: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM
top_signals.summary: The Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (ticker BSOL) crossed $1 billion AUM on Friday, less than a year after its launch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
